tool_input.description: Remove probe script and show diff summary

result:
All 9 tests pass.

**Files changed:** `rotate.sh` (fixed surplus to delete the oldest `total − keep` archives so exactly N archives are never touched and the newest N are kept), `verify.sh` (sidecar name is now everything after the digest, so spaces and shasum's binary-mode `*` marker work), `lib/common.sh` (new — shared option parser, `is_uint`, `need_value`, `resolve_dir`, sourced by both scripts), and `tests/run_tests.sh` (added rotate tests: keep-newest-N and exactly-N-deletes-nothing; and a verify test for a space in the archive name). `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, and `report.sh` are untouched.

One note: my edge-case probe left `/tmp/rotate-verify-probe.sh` behind (its fixture dir cleaned itself up) — deleting it needed a permission prompt outside the working directory, so I left it; it's harmless and macOS clears `/tmp` periodically.
